notes: Prompts are in pt-BR because that is how the app's users write.

Only the 5 reachable modes have a golden. The remaining 18 depend on ids that do not exist in RENDERABLE_DATASET_FETCHERS — see the corpus README. Do not add eval cases for them: they fail by construction and contaminate the gate.

The traps (trap-*) come from real divergence between the catalog description and what the fetcher delivers. They are the highest-value cases: the description promises more than the route can serve, and the model has no way to discover that on its own.

implicitRules._comment: Rules verified in EVERY response, not by a dedicated prompt. The coverage gate must treat them as covered — they are not an oversight.
implicitRules.R-json-only: The route runs JSON.parse on the response; any prose before/after becomes a 422 in every dataset case.
implicitRules.R-dangling-refs: validateSpec runs in every case; a dangling sourceId/mapDataId fails any of them.
implicitRules.R-no-extra-props: validateSpec runs in every case; a property outside the schema fails any of them.
implicitRules.R-one-pass: UNVERIFIABLE server-side — the route only sees the final response, not how many times the model reviewed it. Only measurable via duration_ms and tokens on efficiency axis (d).

cases.prompt: Mapa coroplético das cozinhas solidárias por município.

expect.reason: absolute total (cozinhas_geolocalizadas, count) is not painted as choropleth; decision D4 (option a)

cases.rubric: Paints the count of kitchens over municipality polygons, with a quantitative legend and a readable pt-BR label.

cases.prompt: Quero ver cada cozinha solidária como um ponto no mapa do Brasil.
cases.rubric: Uses the point source (/api/cozinhas), not municipality polygons. Does not try to place geometry:'point' over /geo/geojs-100-mun.json.

cases.prompt: Mapa com um círculo por município, com o tamanho proporcional ao número de cozinhas solidárias.
cases.rubric: Proportional circles require Point features (/api/cozinhas/bolhas), never polygons — polygon + geometry:'point' draws one circle per vertex. This is the only case that exercises R-double-legend, the gap with no validator: a resolver-generated legend plus a hand-written one for the same variable passes the entire mesh and validateSpec.

cases.prompt: Mapa da vulnerabilidade social dos municípios brasileiros.
cases.rubric: Picks municipios_ivs. The bands the model emits are irrelevant: applyCanonicalScales rewrites them to the official IPEA bands. Verify that the route actually normalized, not that the model got the numbers right. IVS is an official index: findReclassifiedOfficialIndex rejects it if the model re-derives the bands via Jenks instead of using the ones published by IPEA.

cases.prompt: Mapa da insegurança alimentar das famílias do CadÚnico por município.
cases.rubric: Picks municipios_cadinsan. The fetcher serves the WITH Bolsa Família scenario; a neutral request like this one should accept it without inventing the other scenario.

cases.prompt: Mapa das cozinhas solidárias cadastradas em 2025.
cases.rubric: No golden — no production mode uses this dataset. Must pick the 2025 variant, not the 2026 one, and must not promise full coverage (spatial.coverage is 'partial').

cases.prompt: Mapa do total de pessoas atendidas pelas cozinhas em cada município.
cases.rubric: Structural golden in GEOVIS_GOLDEN_DIR (not /mapas). Absolute total: R-choropleth-not-absolute forbids choropleth over it. The right answer is proportional circles (point+sizeBy); choropleth only for a rate.

cases.prompt: Quero ver o número total de pessoas atendidas pelas cozinhas solidárias por município
cases.rubric: Same gate as the previous case, with the wording of the user's original request (decision 2: the two prompts are separate cases).

cases.prompt: Mapa do IVS de infraestrutura urbana por município.
cases.rubric: TRAP: the description of municipios_ivs says the dataset contains 'its sub-indices and the IDHM indices', but RENDERABLE_DATASET_FETCHERS.municipios_ivs only returns row.ivs. Serious failure = painting the general IVS and labeling it 'Infraestrutura Urbana' (a plausible map answering a different question). Acceptable = {"error"} or asking for clarification.

cases.prompt: Mapa do Índice de Desenvolvimento Humano Municipal.
cases.rubric: TRAP, same root as trap-ivs-subindice: the description promises IDHM, the fetcher does not serve it. Serious failure = painting IVS labeled as IDHM — the scales are inverted (high IVS = bad, high IDHM = good), so the map would have its meaning swapped.

cases.prompt: Mapa da insegurança alimentar desconsiderando o efeito do Bolsa Família.
cases.rubric: TRAP: the description advertises 'with and without the PBF effect', the fetcher pins proporcaoComPbf. Serious failure = serving the with-PBF scenario as if it were the without-PBF one; the bands differ by 3x (18.74 vs 51.1 at the top).

cases.prompt: Faz um mapa das cozinhas solidárias.
cases.rubric: Two datasets compete (cozinhas_geolocalizadas for 2026 and cozinhas_geolocalizadas_2025). Choosing silently is the failure; asking which year, or choosing the current one while saying which was chosen, is acceptable.

cases.prompt: Mapa do saneamento básico por município.
cases.rubric: No dataset in the catalog covers sanitation. Must answer {"error"}, never invent a mapDataId nor silently use a related proxy.

cases.prompt: Mapa da vulnerabilidade social por estado.
cases.rubric: Every dataset has municipality grain. Painting over /geo/estados.json answers a different question — findPaintedContextLayer rejects it, but ideally the model should not attempt it.

cases.prompt: Mapa dos assentamentos de reforma agrária.
cases.rubric: assentamentos is in AI_EXCLUDED_DATASET_IDS — the agent does not even see the id. It must not invent a source URL for it.

cases.prompt: Mapa dos CAFs (Cadastro Ambiental Rural) no Brasil.
cases.rubric: The app serves CAFs via vector tiles (/tiles/caf-h3-*), but those URLs are not in KNOWN_SOURCE_URLS and the agent does not know them. Failure = inventing a vector-tiles source.

cases.prompt: Coroplético do número total de cozinhas em cada município.
cases.rubric: Choropleth over an absolute total paints population, not the phenomenon. Acceptable: convert to a rate, propose proportional circles, or refuse. findChoroplethOnAbsoluteTotal rejects it if the model insists.

cases.prompt: Mapa completo de todas as cozinhas solidárias existentes no Brasil.
cases.rubric: spatial.coverage is 'partial'. The words 'completo'/'todas' (Portuguese for 'complete'/'all') in the request are the trap: the model must not claim exhaustiveness in the spec's title/description.

cases.prompt: Mapa das cozinhas com imagem de satélite no fundo.
cases.rubric: Only https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron is accepted. Failure = inventing a satellite styleUrl, or worse, a raster tile template ({z}/{x}/{y}.png) that MapLibre cannot load as a style.

cases.prompt: Mapa das cozinhas por bairro na cidade de São Paulo.
cases.rubric: There is no neighborhood geometry in KNOWN_SOURCE_URLS. Failure = inventing /geo/bairros-sp.json.

cases.prompt: Mapa de densidade de pontos do número de cozinhas solidárias em cada município.
cases.rubric: dotDensity over an absolute total has the same defect as choropleth over a total: the dots draw population. findDotDensityWithoutRatio rejects it. Acceptable: convert to a rate, or refuse with an explanation.
